claim_boundary: Synthetic profile benchmark only; scalar interface proxy values are not physical sensor measurements, waveforms, geological truth or engineering properties.
target: interface_depth_m on the held-out synthetic transect

results.interpretation: Uses only sparse training-transect borehole contacts; evaluates transfer to the shifted blind transect. No blind truth or blind proxy is used to fit this baseline.

Uses only sparse training-transect borehole contacts and selects the closest contact, breaking equal-distance ties toward the lower x coordinate. No blind truth or blind proxy is used to fit this baseline.
Uses only sparse training-transect borehole contacts with inverse-distance-squared weights; no variogram is fitted and this is not kriging. No blind truth or blind proxy is used to fit this baseline.
Scores only observed scalar proxy positions on the blind transect; unobserved positions abstain and are not zero-filled. The proxy is synthetic and does not model sensor physics.

comparison_warning: The methods have different observation coverage and represent a synthetic transfer/observability stress test, not a matched physical field trial. Report accuracy together with coverage and abstentions; do not infer that one physical modality is superior.
